idea_name: Dual-buffer zero↔nonzero direction-change alert on external indicators
mechanism: For color-change indicators that paint one line via two buffers (static colors; only the active buffer holds >0 while the inactive is 0), scan up to 8 iCustom buffers from StartBar over ExtBars and fire alert/comment/sound/VLine when (Second==0 && First>0) or (Second>0 && First==0) on consecutive bars.
data_needed: Named custom indicator EX4; buffer indices 0..7; StartBar; ExtBars (~150)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: chart Symbol()/Period(); example Slope Trend_mtf; any attached instrument
why_new_for_mis: Turns opaque Wingdings/color-buffer indicators into an explicit regime-direction change sensor without needing indicator source.
quote: When the indicator value changes from zero to a significant one, including the reverse change, i.e. from a significant value to zero, the user must be notified.

idea_name: Fractal-anchored parallel price channel with RatePr slope regime
mechanism: Search fully formed fractals with period-scaled B_F windows via iLowest/iHighest over AllB bars; take two same-side extrema as datum points; RatePr=(Pr2-Pr1)/(NB2-NB1) (sign → upward/downward); project opposite parallel boundary from the extremum between them; compute TLUp/TLDn/Med on last 6 bars.
data_needed: OHLC High/Low; AllB (~240); Period()-dependent B_F (M1:12 … W1:6)
why_new_for_mis: Explicit local channel-direction regime from fractal geometry plus continuous slope RatePr, not a fixed MA trend label.
quote: if the value is positive, we are dealing with a downward channel, otherwise - upward.

mechanism: Alert when Bid>TLUp_[0] or Bid<TLDn_[0]; if a new fractal forms beyond the opposite boundary, recompute RatePr—if the new extremum is past both prior datum points the channel direction flips (upward↔downward), else only slope adjusts.
data_needed: Live Bid vs projected TLUp/TLDn; new High[2]/Low[2] fractal vs prior NB1/NB2 prices
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Symbol()/Period(); same multi-TF B_F table; breakout marks on chart
why_new_for_mis: Separates soft breakout touch from hard regime flip when fractal geometry invalidates the prior channel direction.
quote: Should the minimum bar value of the formed fractal be also lower than the second reference point, the channel direction will become downward.

mechanism: EA shells a Java jar that renews Google Calendar SMS events so missed heartbeats imply terminal/PC failure—ops connectivity, not market sensing.
data_needed: Google Calendar credentials; PERI minutes; MODE 0/1
why_new_for_mis: Infrastructure SMS keepalive; no regime/vol/liquidity sensor.
quote: if the current message is not deleted by 9.59 am ... if the Terminal does not get connected with Google server ... an SMS will be sent

mechanism: Graphic EA/script/indicator suite for opening/modifying/closing orders by dragging horizontal lines and control-panel icons—trade UI chrome, not market sensing.
data_needed: order lines OpenPrice/SL/TP; control-panel AG functions
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: any chart for manual trading UI
why_new_for_mis: Order-management GUI; no price-regime or volatility sensor.
quote: A graphic Expert Advisor, AutoGraf, is graphic in the sense that shape objects are used in it in order to create a convenient interface.

idea_name: Triangular-slider live RSI×MA signal profitability stability map
mechanism: OBJ_TRIANGLE mid-vertex maps continuous MAPeriod/RSIPeriod/RSILevel; on each tick recompute Buy/Sell from RSI cross of RSILevel confirmed by MA vs MA×3, draw deal ZZ and cumulative balance histogram so parameter moves instantly reveal stability vs fragility of the signal.
data_needed: iRSI/iMA on chart bars; DateStart/DateEnd; LotForCalc; slider ranges MA 5–35, RSI 2–25, level 5–95
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Helen HI_Line RSI+MA example; EURUSD M30 cited; usable on M5/M15/M30/D1
why_new_for_mis: Turns parameter sensitivity itself into a live sensing surface for whether a classical oscillator signal is locally stable.
quote: You simply select triangular sliders and start moving their midpoints up/down. ... try to grasp what these moves lead to.

idea_name: CSV economic-calendar event overlay as scheduled risk sensor
mechanism: FileOpen CSV of dated macro events; parse date/time/country/description/prev/forecast/current; country-color VLINEs and optional angled OBJ_TEXT on chart; boolean country filters gate which releases are shown so traders see upcoming volatility windows on price.
data_needed: week.txt-style CSV (YYYY.MM.DD HH:MM; country; series; values); country filter flags
why_new_for_mis: Fundamental-event schedule as an explicit exogenous volatility/liquidity-risk sensor aligned to the price path.
quote: It would be very convenient if all key events of the trade day were displayed in the price chart.
